recreation_entertainment_activity.value: Casino resorts: gaming, hotel, dining and spa at Atlantis in Reno and Monarch in Black Hawk, Colorado

venue_service_capacity.value: Two casino resorts: Atlantis with 817 rooms, ~61,000 sq ft casino; Monarch Black Hawk with 516 rooms, ~60,000 sq ft casino

admission_yield.value: Casinos do not charge admission; revenue comes from gaming, rooms, food and beverage, and spa

pass_membership_mix.value: No pass or membership model; guests visit casinos and book rooms, tables, treatments and events

gaming_economics_gaming_businesses.value: Slot and table game win at both resorts: about 1,200 slots and 33 tables at Atlantis; over 1,000 slots and 37 tables at Black Hawk, plus poker and sportsbook
